definitions: A weapon for shooting arrows, typically made of a curved piece of wood joined at both ends by a taut string.
A knot tied with two loops and two loose ends, used for decoration or tying shoelaces.
A rod with horsehair stretched along its length, used for playing stringed instruments.
The forward part of the hull of a ship or boat.
A bending of the head or body in greeting, respect, or submission.
examples: A silk bow in her hair.
Standing at the bow of the ship.
A polite bow to the audience.
